title: My first game release ever: Frontier Pool, 3D hyperrealistic pool in your browser
author: Dota2playre

comments.author: Dota2playre
comments.body:
It took me almost four weeks to polish this enough to be ready for release.

Hyperrealistic physics, multiplayer, local play, and a decent AI opponent. Trailer made with Opus, development assisted by Codex, Claude, and Grok.

Playable at: [https://frontierpool.online](https://frontierpool.online)

Bug reports and suggestions for improvement are welcome!
